item.title: A Little Snitch for Windows
item.description:
📝 Asks once, remembers The first time an app tries to connect, you see who made it, where it's going and on which port. Click Allow or Block, for the whole app or just one address, host or domain, and keep it forever or only until the app quits.
🔗 Read more: https://packethound.app/

item.title: UK House of Lords to propose mandatory CSAM detection software on smartphones
item.description:
📝 Images and videos of child sexual abuse, including AI-generated material, would be instantly blurred, and livestreaming of abuse would become impossible. Analysts also found 3,440 AI-generated videos of child sexual abuse, compared with only 13 in 2024. Only 6% are very confident that the tech companies are doing enough to detect and remove child sexual abuse material.
🔗 Read more: https://observer.co.uk/news/national/article/fight-to-block-child-sexual-abuse-images-unites-peers-and-mps-in-cross-party-campaign
